files.adaptations: Wrapped Up/Down and first-item focus navigation translated into a local delegated menu keyboard listener. Native activation and existing popover dismissal remain in Lolly.
Modern focus-change and nearest option scrolling behavior adapted to native menuitem focus and scrollIntoView. Existing language and design-system menus reuse this helper.

Prepared per-axis target buckets adapted from make-insert-tree-data and query patterns into sorted arrays built lazily on the first eligible snap query and reused during the gesture. Original Lolly target insertion ordinals remain tie breakers; worker and Rx transports are not copied.

Bounded axis query pattern adapted from snap-accuracy-ranges and closest-snap to binary searches for nearest targets within the existing screen-scaled threshold. Lolly retains angled guides and existing target visibility and locking semantics.

Modern WASM viewport guide-pill-axis, guide-pill and guide-overlay interaction behavior adapted to native keyed DOM feedback, a three-screen-pixel drag threshold and a lazy coordinate editor. Lolly retains document coordinates and angled guides; frame-bound guide ownership is not copied.

Modern draw_selection_x/y bands, endpoint label spacing, outer masks and format_label adapted from the Rust UI overlay to keyed DOM feedback at constant screen size. Lolly retains its existing 1/2/5 tick intervals and cached tick geometry; the legacy SVG ruler is not a reuse origin.
